entities.description: A tall, slender flagpole with a metallic finish stands vertically, topped with a golden spherical finial. A portion of a flag is visible on the right side of the pole, showing red and white colors, while the background is a clear, light blue sky.

A close-up, eye-level shot of a weathered white marble statue of a male figure with curly hair, wearing a draped toga secured by a circular brooch on the right shoulder. The statue has a serene, classical expression and is positioned in front of a blurred red, white, and blue flag against a pale sky.

attributes.condition: weathered with dark spots and discoloration

clothing.details: heavy folds, draped over left shoulder, secured with a spiral-shaped fibula or brooch on the right shoulder

attributes.pose: standing, upper body visible, head turned slightly to the side

background.flag: red, white, and blue horizontal stripes, out of focus
